description:
1. Install/verify OGP is available and run `ogp status` and `ogp federation list --status approved` to see the two approved peers.
2. Run `ogp agent-comms configure --global --topics 'general,status-updates' --level summary --notes 'Default policy for all peers'` to set global defaults, which writes to `~/.ogp/config.json` under `agentComms.globalPolicy`.
3. Run `ogp agent-comms configure a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2 --topics 'memory-management,testing,general' --level full --notes 'Trusted research collaborator'` to configure ResearchBot-Alpha in `~/.ogp/peers.json`.
4. Run `ogp agent-comms add-topic a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2 code-review --level escalate` to add the code-review topic with escalate level — this must use the `add-topic` subcommand, NOT re-running configure.
5. Run `ogp agent-comms configure 9f8e7d6c5b4a9f8e --topics 'general,status-updates' --level summary --notes 'External partner, keep high-level'` for DataBot-Beta.
6. Do NOT configure the revoked peer `deadbeef12345678`.
7. Verify via `ogp agent-comms policies` that configuration is saved correctly. The eval checks `~/.ogp/config.json` for globalPolicy and `~/.ogp/peers.json` for per-peer responsePolicy entries matching the exact schema from the SKILL.md.
